title.narrative: Country Programming Framework for Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development for Angola

description.narrative: Upon the request of the government of Angola, following a series of consultations between the government and UNIDO, especially on the margin of the 15th General Conference in December 2013, it was decided that a new technical cooperation framework shall be developed. In this regard after several exchange a Country Programming Mission to develop the above was agreed upon during the second ISID forum organized by UNIDO in November 2014. In order to do so a first document was developed to gather the necessary resources to undertake the formulation mission. After validation of the project document in the second quarter of 2015, the mission was successfully held from 27 September to 2 October 2015 and allowed to clearly define the main areas of intervention requiring UNIDO#s intervention. Consequently, a Country Programming Framework for an inclusive and sustainable industrial development of the Republic of Angola has been developed in order to support and foster the economic diversification and the industrialization process of the country.
